helpIntro: Northwestern uses a 4.0 undergraduate scale. Enter Northwestern course units and grades to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For the standard Evanston undergraduate record. X and Y count as 0.0 in this profile; graduate incompletes are treated differently. Repeat Impact is unavailable because Northwestern counts all graded attempts. External transfer grades are excluded.
helpExample: A 1-unit A earns 4.0 grade points and a 1-unit B+ earns 3.3; together, 7.3 ÷ 2 = 3.65.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.0 grade points per course unit.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0; whether it satisfies a requirement depends on the school/program.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.0 and counts in the undergraduate GPA.
gradeExplanations.X: Undergraduate X = 0.0 while unresolved; it can later change to a final grade.
gradeExplanations.Y: Undergraduate Y = 0.0 while unresolved; it can later change to a final grade.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass with credit; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.N: No grade/no credit; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory noncredit notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory noncredit notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawal by permission; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NR: No grade reported; excluded until resolved.

specialTypes.name: Northwestern undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use the final Northwestern undergraduate grade and Northwestern course units.

specialTypes.name: Northwestern direct-credit study abroad
specialTypes.note: Northwestern -SA/direct-credit courses appear with letter grades and count in term and cumulative GPA.

specialTypes.name: External transfer or transfer-credit study abroad
specialTypes.note: Accepted external transfer grades are recorded as T/transfer credit and do not enter the Northwestern GPA.

specialTypes.name: Course transferred from another Northwestern career
specialTypes.note: Some accepted courses from another Northwestern career retain prior grades and can count; confirm the posted undergraduate record before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed course. Both grades count in GPA; the calculator does not decide duplicate credit or repeat eligibility.
